entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A bookish young planeswalker who casts a control spell on the Blood Avatar and loses his lower right leg.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: Will's twin sister, who draws on the Snarl, burns Extus, collapses from the backlash, and then feeds Will her power.

entities.name: Extus
entities.description: The Oriq leader who summons the Blood Avatar and is crushed by it.

entities.name: Blood Avatar
entities.description: A four-armed war creature summoned from the Snarl, which wrecks the Hall of Oracles and is finally pulled back into the Snarl.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A bonder who controls the mage hunters and flees with Mila when the dragons burn them.

entities.name: Mila
entities.description: Lukka's fox companion.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer who returns after being teleported away, accepts a permanent professor post under her real name, and puts away her research on Gideon.

entities.name: Nassari
entities.description: An efreet dean who helps rescue the twins from the collapsing Hall of Oracles.

entities.name: Lisette
entities.description: A Witherbloom dean who helps rescue the twins and tends Will's wound.

entities.name: Uvilda
entities.description: A Prismari dean who seals escaped students into an emergency dimension.

entities.name: Plink
entities.description: A Witherbloom friend of Rowan crawling through a root tunnel.

entities.name: Auvernine
entities.description: A Witherbloom friend of Rowan crawling through a root tunnel.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: A watcher who sees through owls and decides the twins now require her attention.

entities.name: Quint
entities.description: Will's friend who helped add runes to his cane.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: A figure whom Will freed and won over as an ally.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: Implied old friend whose memory Liliana bids farewell.

entities.name: Mage hunters
entities.description: Insect-like creatures controlled by Lukka until the dragons burn them, after which they turn on the Oriq.

entities.name: Dragons
entities.description: The Founder dragons whose fire scours the campus.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: Masked mages whose attack fails and who are attacked by freed mage hunters.

entities.name: Strixhaven Snarl
entities.description: A nexus of primordial power that turns crimson during the summoning and which Rowan drains.

entities.name: Hall of Oracles
entities.description: The oracle hall that collapses during the fight.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university that recovers after the attack.

events.summary: Extus gloats before the oracle statues as the Blood Avatar rises.
events.quote: He whirled, gesturing wildly at the statues surrounding him.

events.summary: The Blood Avatar's axe splits a statue of a former oracle.
events.quote: the Blood Avatar's axe hit one of the statues, splitting the likeness of a former oracle in half

events.summary: Across campus, Lukka feels the roar while controlling the mage hunters and tells Mila that Extus got what he wanted.
events.quote: It found Lukka, even through the concentration it took from him to keep all the mage hunters fighting on several fronts.

events.summary: Dragonfire kills nearby mage hunters, and Lukka severs the link to avoid being overwhelmed.
events.quote: he severed the link before he could be overwhelmed

events.summary: Freed mage hunters turn on the nearest Oriq agents.
events.quote: turned on the nearest source of magical sustenance: Oriq agents

events.summary: Lukka decides this is no longer his fight and flees with Mila.
events.quote: Calling Mila to his side, Lukka turned and ran into the dark.

events.summary: Will's ice shards at Extus are blown apart by Rowan's lightning.
events.quote: a bolt of lightning cracked through the shards, detonating them

events.summary: Rubble knocks Will down, and Rowan fails to hurt the Blood Avatar's sword.
events.quote: The monster only pulled its sword free, throwing her backward.

events.summary: Rowan reaches out and draws on the power of the Snarl.
events.quote: Rowan took a deep breath, closed her eyes, and reached out.

events.summary: Extus sees the Blood Avatar faltering as the Snarl's energy flows into Rowan.
events.quote: The creature was moving in jerks and fits, the red light of the Snarl flickering wildly behind it.

events.summary: Rowan blasts Extus with fire that hurls him against the wall.
events.quote: the spell crashed into him, sending him flying through the air, robes coiling with smoke

events.summary: The Snarl's power backfires and Rowan collapses, drained.
events.quote: All the strength abruptly left her limbs and she flopped limply out of the air

events.summary: Extus dismisses Rowan's ambition and returns to his ritual.
events.quote: But I've come too far to be stopped by the likes of you.

events.summary: The twins apologize to each other for their fights.
events.quote: I'm sorry about the fight.

events.summary: Will realizes the Blood Avatar can be controlled like the Mage Tower mascot.
events.quote: It's like a mascot!

events.summary: Will casts a red halo control spell on the Blood Avatar's head.
events.quote: Suddenly, a red halo of light snapped into place around the Blood Avatar's helmed head.

events.summary: Rowan pours her last magical energy into Will, completing the spell.
events.quote: Rowan poured the last of her magical energy into her brother

events.summary: The controlled Blood Avatar crushes Extus.
events.quote: one of the massive hands of the Blood Avatar closed around him with an awful crunching sound

events.summary: The spell breaks and the Blood Avatar's sword takes Will's lower right leg as it is pulled back into the Snarl.
events.quote: below the knee, his right leg was gone

events.summary: As the hall collapses, Deans Nassari and Lisette rescue the twins.
events.quote: Brows furrowed in concentration, they sent gouts of magic through the air, blasting away falling rocks and debris.

events.summary: Nassari assures Rowan that Will will live.
events.quote: He'll live,

events.summary: Five weeks later Will refuses a living wood leg and uses an ice-and-steel prosthesis.
events.quote: He had refused the offers from Dean Lisette of a living wood replacement.

events.summary: Will insists they should stay and study because they beat the Avatar with a spell learned at Strixhaven.
events.quote: We took down a Blood Avatar with a spell that we learned here

events.summary: Rowan, noticeably thinner, tells Will she loves him.
events.quote: You know I love you, right?

events.summary: Kasmina surveys the restored campus and the memorial statue.
events.quote: The damage from the attack was all but erased; cobbles replaced, hedges regrown.

events.summary: Kasmina sees Lukka wandering with Mila and remaining Oriq, but turns her attention to the twins.
events.quote: But he was no longer worth watching.

events.summary: Liliana returns to Strixhaven and the deans invite her to remain a professor indefinitely.
events.quote: they had invited her to remain a professor at the university indefinitely

events.summary: Liliana puts away her research journals, parting from her old friend.
events.quote: It seems this is where we finally part, old friend.

events.summary: Liliana introduces herself to her class as Professor Liliana Vess.
events.quote: My name is Professor Liliana Vess.

relations.quote: one of the massive hands of the Blood Avatar closed around him with an awful crunching sound
Looks like Extus got what he wanted.
like something vital had been sucked clean out of his sister
Calling Mila to his side, Lukka turned and ran into the dark.

relations.note: Quint helped him add runes to his cane.
relations.quote: the runes Quint had helped him put into place

relations.note: Will found a way to free Garruk and win him over as an ally.
relations.quote: it was Will who had finally found a way to free Garruk and win him over as an ally
